title: The D4vd Case: The Evidence, the Allegations and What Happens Next

narration: A Hollywood tow yard reported a smell coming from an impounded Tesla.
shots.visual_description: tow yard night (night grade); searcher_b (silhouette): stand -> hand_to_face -> point (walks); camera push/pull, handheld; overlays: label 'HOLLYWOOD · SEPTEMBER 2025'.

sources.claim_text: On 8 Sept 2025, after tow-yard workers reported an odour, police found human remains in the front trunk of an impounded Tesla at a Hollywood tow yard; the car was registered to David Anthony Burke, the singer known as D4vd.

narration: Inside its front trunk were human remains.
The car was registered to the singer D4vd.
shots.visual_description: tow yard night (night grade); detective (silhouette): examine -> stand; agent_b (silhouette): arms_crossed -> read; camera push/pull; overlays: card 'VEHICLE REGISTERED TO: / DAVID ANTHONY BURKE / THE SINGER D4VD'.

overlays.text: VEHICLE REGISTERED TO: / DAVID ANTHONY BURKE / THE SINGER D4VD

sources.claim_text: On 8 Sept 2025, after tow-yard workers reported an odour, police found human remains in the front trunk of an impounded Tesla at a Hollywood tow yard; the car was registered to David Anthony Burke, the singer known as D4vd.

narration: The remains were identified as Celeste Rivas Hernandez, of Lake Elsinore, California.

sources.claim_text: The LA County Medical Examiner identified the remains (about 16-17 Sept 2025) as Celeste Rivas Hernandez of Lake Elsinore, California. No charges followed until April 2026.

narration: Months passed with no charges.
Then, in April 2026, police arrested the singer, David Anthony Burke.
shots.visual_description: task force (cold grade); detective (silhouette): arms_crossed -> point_up -> stand; camera push/pull, handheld.

sources.claim_text: The LA County Medical Examiner identified the remains (about 16-17 Sept 2025) as Celeste Rivas Hernandez of Lake Elsinore, California. No charges followed until April 2026.
LAPD arrested Burke on 16 April 2026 and held him without bail on suspicion of murder.

narration: He is charged with murder, with special circumstances,
continuous sexual abuse of a child under fourteen,
and unlawful mutilation of human remains.
shots.visual_description: press room (cold grade); agent_a (silhouette): stand -> present -> hands_together -> present; keyed camera moves, handheld; overlays: card 'CHARGED · 20 APRIL 2026 / MURDER + SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES / CONTINUOUS SEXUAL ABUSE OF A CHILD UNDER 14 / UNLAWFUL MUTILATION OF HUMAN REMAINS / ALLEGATIONS · HE HAS PLEADED NOT GUILTY'.

overlays.text: CHARGED · 20 APRIL 2026 / MURDER + SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES / CONTINUOUS SEXUAL ABUSE OF A CHILD UNDER 14 / UNLAWFUL MUTILATION OF HUMAN REMAINS / ALLEGATIONS · HE HAS PLEADED NOT GUILTY

sources.claim_text: On 20 April 2026 the DA charged Burke with murder with special-circumstance allegations (lying in wait, financial gain, killing a witness), continuous sexual abuse of a child under 14, and unlawful mutilation of human remains. These are allegations.

narration: Prosecutors allege Celeste went to his home on April 23rd, 2025, aged fourteen,
and was never seen alive again.
shots.visual_description: hills rain (night grade); camera push/pull, handheld; overlays: svg.
shots.reconstruction_tag: ILLUSTRATION · GENERIC HOUSE, NOT THE REAL HOME

sources.claim_text: Prosecutors allege Celeste went to Burke's Hollywood Hills home on 23 April 2025 at his invitation, aged 14, and was not seen alive after that date. This is the prosecution's allegation, not a finding.

narration: He has pleaded not guilty.
His lawyers said the evidence would show he did not murder her.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (cold grade); press_operator (silhouette): hands_together; agent_a (silhouette): stand -> present; official (silhouette): hands_together; camera push/pull; overlays: label 'PLEA: NOT GUILTY', card 'DEFENCE (FORMER COUNSEL) · APRIL 2026 / THE EVIDENCE WILL SHOW HE / 'DID NOT MURDER CELESTE / RIVAS HERNANDEZ''.

overlays.text: DEFENCE (FORMER COUNSEL) · APRIL 2026 / THE EVIDENCE WILL SHOW HE / 'DID NOT MURDER CELESTE / RIVAS HERNANDEZ'

sources.claim_text: Burke pleaded not guilty at his arraignment on 20 April 2026, and again on 31 August 2026.
His then lawyers said the evidence would show he did not murder Celeste Rivas Hernandez and vowed to defend his innocence.

narration: In July, a judge ruled there was enough evidence for a trial, on every charge.
That is not a verdict.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (cold grade); official (silhouette): sit -> gavel -> sit; camera push/pull; overlays: label 'PRELIMINARY HEARING', stamp 'HELD TO ANSWER', card 'A RULING TO GO TO TRIAL / IS NOT A VERDICT'.

overlays.text: A RULING TO GO TO TRIAL / IS NOT A VERDICT

sources.claim_text: On 27 July 2026, after a five-day preliminary hearing, Judge Charlaine Olmedo held Burke to answer on all counts and all three special-circumstance allegations. A holding order is not a verdict.

narration: Then his high-profile lawyers withdrew. A public defender took over.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (cold grade); press_operator (silhouette): hands_together; agent_a (silhouette): stand (walks); official (silhouette): stand (walks); analyst (silhouette): stand (walks); camera push/pull; overlays: label '31 AUGUST 2026', label 'PLEA AGAIN: NOT GUILTY'.

sources.claim_text: On 31 August 2026 his private lawyers were allowed to withdraw and the LA County Public Defender's Office was appointed; he pleaded not guilty again.

narration: There is still no trial date, and prosecutors have not decided on the death penalty.
shots.visual_description: task force (cold grade); detective (silhouette): arms_crossed -> hand_to_face; camera push/pull.

sources.claim_text: As of the latest reports (Sept 2026) no trial date has been set and the DA has not decided whether to seek the death penalty.

narration: His next hearing is set for October 19th.
That is when both sides are expected to say whether they are ready for trial.
shots.visual_description: courthouse night (night grade); agent_b (silhouette): stand (walks); keyed camera moves; overlays: svg.

sources.claim_text: The next hearing was set for 19 October 2026, when the attorneys are to confirm whether they are ready for trial (reported 31 Aug 2026; no later change found on 2026-10-11).

narration: Until a jury decides, he is presumed innocent. Celeste's family is still waiting.
shots.visual_description: courthouse night (night grade); searcher_b (silhouette): stand (walks); camera push/pull; overlays: svg.

sources.claim_text: Burke has pleaded not guilty and is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty at trial.
Celeste's family has said, through their attorney, that they want justice for her, and in September 2026 called for the death penalty if he is convicted.
